title: Arkret Actor Profile Operations
description: Authorized, anti-enumeration projection of another principal's global Actor Profile. A global profile Event lives in its owner's Principal Control Realm, so a co-member cannot reach it through an ordinary Realm-scoped read and MUST NOT reach it through a cross-principal actor selector. This operation is the only outward carrier for that PCR-resident fact: it is gated on a current shared Realm, returns the exact signed profile Event with its covering Seal, and never discloses any other PCR Event.

resolve_request.description: Resolves current global Actor Profiles for actors the caller currently shares realm_id with. The caller MUST be an effective joined member of realm_id and every returned actor MUST also be one at evaluation time; realm_id is the authorization basis, not a display hint.

realm_id.description: Shared Collaboration Realm establishing the relationship. A Principal Control Realm MUST NOT be used here: PCR co-membership is the owner's own devices and would make this operation a self-read with an outward shape.

profile_event.description: The exact accepted profile Event that produced the returned projection. Its envelope realm_id is the owner's Principal Control Realm; disclosing this Event is the declared exposure for ak.profile.create and ak.profile.update and does not extend to any other kind in that Realm.

resolved_actor_profile.description: One actor's current global profile with the evidence needed to verify it independently. The consumer recomputes the projection from profile_event and checks that accepted_seal covers profile_event.event_digest; a bare actor_profile is a server assertion, not evidence.

accepted_seal.description: Accepted Seal in the owner's Principal Control Realm covering profile_event.event_digest. It is disclosed only as coverage evidence for that exact Event and MUST NOT be used to enumerate the Realm's other sealed Events.

resolve_failure.description: Per-actor failure. The reason vocabulary is deliberately single-valued: unknown actor, actor without an accepted profile, actor that is not an effective joined member of realm_id, and a caller not authorized for that actor MUST all report profile_unavailable so the operation cannot be used to probe membership or account existence.

resolve_outcome.description: Closed outcome. Every requested actor_id appears exactly once across profiles and failures, so a caller cannot distinguish an omitted actor from a withheld one.
